en: What is this strange jar?
A teapot, obviously!
No! It feels earthquakes!
China made it 1,900 years ago.
A ball fell into the frog!
But nobody felt anything!
Days later, news came: an earthquake far away!
Smarter than my phone!

en: He thought it was a teapot. It is an earthquake detector made in China about 1,900 years ago.
When a ball fell from a dragon into a frog's mouth, it showed the direction of a quake that nobody nearby had felt.
Send this to the friend who always answers with confidence and is always wrong.
